descriptions.preferred: The name means "floating clouds" and refers to the subtle variegation of the leaves which gave rise to the exof very minute dots. Most leaves are marked in varying degrees by white or pink spots, sometimes merging into large areas. Other leaves are totally white or light pink. None of the coloration is garish—it is soft. The five-lobed leaves measure 4-6 cm long and wide. The lobes radiate openly and separate three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. They are long-ovate ending in a sharp tip. The lobes that are highly colored do not lie flat but may curl downwards or sideways. Often they are twisted and undulate. The margins are finely and regularly toothed. This plant is not a rapid grower. The twigs are rather short and slightly multibranched, forming a semidense plant. 'Ukigumo' becomes a tall shrub, probably reaching 3 m after many years.

sources.title: 浮云 Acer Palmatum 'Ukigumo'
sources.description: 浮云的基本叶色为浅绿色，在边缘有淡淡的粉红色， 叶面上还会散落着一些绿色斑点。但浮云出锦需要 温差，一般北方会更适合浮云。秋天橙黄色。浮云 的叶子一般是 5 裂，叶片开张，叶裂很深，出锦的 叶片会向下或向侧面卷曲。生长速度一般，成年树 高大约 3 米。

sources.name: Ukigumo Variegated Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Ukigumo Japanese Maple is a stunning variegated variety known for its striking foliage and unique appearance. Often referred to as the “Floating Cloud” maple due to its light, airy feel, the Ukigumo features leaves that emerge as a soft green with creamy white variegation, creating a beautiful contrast. As the season progresses, the colors transform, with the leaves transitioning to shades of pink, white, and green, offering a constantly changing visual display throughout the year. The UkigumoJapanese maple available for sale is perfect for those looking to add an unusual and eye-catching element to their garden or landscape. Typically growing to a height of 2.5 to 3 meters, the Ukigumo is well-suited for small to medium-sized gardens, as well as container planting. Its delicate, finely dissected leaves and compact size make it an excellent choice for accenting other plants or creating a serene focal point. The Ukigumo thrives in well-drained soil and partial shade, and it is relatively low-maintenance once established. Its unique variegation makes it a standout tree that can elevate any landscape, whether in a Japanese-inspired garden, a contemporary setting, or as part of a mixed border. rhs.description: A deciduous, bushy, small to medium-sized shrub, eventually reaching a height of around 3m. The five-lobed, slightly-twisted leaves emerge predominantly white in the spring, with pink tips and shading, before maturing to green heavily-mottled and edged with white and pink

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Further Japanese maple cultivation advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“浮云”，指叶片上细腻的斑锦变化，仿佛由极其细小的斑点构成。多数叶片会以不同程度分布白色或粉色斑点，有时会融合成较大的色块；也有些叶片几乎全白或浅粉。整体色彩并不艳俗，而是十分柔和。五裂叶长宽均为 4-6 厘米。裂片向外舒展，分裂至叶基约四分之三处，裂片为长卵形，先端锐尖。着色较重的裂片往往不平展，可能向下或向侧面卷曲，且常有扭转和波浪状起伏。叶缘细密且规则具锯齿。该品种生长不快，枝条较短，且略多分枝，形成半致密株形。‘Ukigumo’ 最终可长成高大灌木，许多年后高度约可达 3 米。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、丛生型小至中型灌木，最终高度约 3 米。叶片 5 裂，略有扭曲，春季萌发时以白色为主，叶尖及局部带粉色晕染；成熟后转为绿色，并带有大量白色与粉色斑驳及镶边。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性良好且排水通畅的土壤中，并选择避风环境。叶色在半阴条件下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐受全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。更多日本枫树栽培建议。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：晚秋至隆冬期间进行
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或以软枝扦插繁殖。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Ukigumo' Floating Clouds Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ukigumo' Ukigumo "Floating Clouds" Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Ukigumo' is a gorgeous upright Japanese maple. Once out of every two or three years, 'Ukigumo' leafs out with spectacular white variegation that covers the leaf. This variegation is environmental and is conditional year to year. Protection from the hot afternoon sun helps a lot with retaining the variegation for the longest amount of time throughout the growing season. One great thing about this maple, it always has a bright golden yellow to orange fall color.
